handback.title: Co-author, owner docs and prompts follow settings
handback.summary: Commits credit the co-author the settings name, and agent prompts follow the repo's docs, paths, caps and house rules.
handback.user_story: A repo's settings decide who commits credit and what every agent's prompt says, house rules included.

acceptance_criteria.text: The co-author line on Dokima's commits comes from the co-author setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The co-author line on Dokima's commits comes from the co-author setting.

edge_cases.case: An empty co-author setting leaves no co-author line.
With no settings file, commits keep today's co-author line.

acceptance_criteria.text: Agents copy the owner docs file the settings name, in place of the rules file.
acceptance_criteria.words: Agents copy the owner docs file the settings name, in place of the rules file.

edge_cases.case: The topic files the owner docs file links are copied too.
Settings naming a missing file still let the run go on.
With no settings file, the rules file is copied as today.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner and worker prompts name the owner docs file the settings name.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner and worker prompts name the owner docs file the settings name.

edge_cases.case: With no settings file, the prompts name the rules file as today.

acceptance_criteria.text: The worker's prompt lists the protected paths the settings name.
acceptance_criteria.words: The worker's prompt lists the protected paths the settings name.

edge_cases.case: With no settings file, the prompt lists the default protected path.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner prompt's runner line is drawn from the test settings.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner prompt's runner line is drawn from the test settings.

edge_cases.case: With no settings file, the line names the default tag.

acceptance_criteria.text: The style prompt's caps table is drawn from the caps setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The style prompt's caps table is drawn from the caps setting.

edge_cases.case: A cap the settings leave out keeps its default.
With no settings file, the table shows today's caps.

acceptance_criteria.text: A repo's house rules file is added after the shipped prompt.
acceptance_criteria.words: A repo's house rules file is added after the shipped prompt.

edge_cases.case: House rules changed only on the agent's branch are never used.
A repo with no house rules file still starts its agent.

acceptance_criteria.text: A house rules section named for a role is added only to that role's prompt.
acceptance_criteria.words: A house rules section named for a role is added only to that role's prompt.

edge_cases.case: A role with no section of its own gets only the shared rules.

raises.label: Two readings
raises.text: Is a role's house rules section a heading naming the role inside the house rules file? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: The ask says section named for a role; issue 741 says per role or for all.

raises.label: Default co-author
raises.text: Should the shipped co-author default stay your line, so this repo still credits you? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: This repo has no settings file yet; issue 780 moves its values there later.
